tasks.short: Provide psychological treatment using appropriate methods

steps.what: Use psychotherapy, behavior modification, stress reduction or other appropriate treatment methods with clients

tasks.design: Keep treatment delivery and response to the client with the qualified psychologist. Existing guidance in {DOCS} supports practice; documentation aids in the digest do not establish a replacement for therapy.
tasks.previous_blocker: Therapeutic work depends on relationship and moment-to-moment clinical judgement.
tasks.enabler_now: Speech-to-note tools address records rather than therapeutic interaction.
tasks.still_hard: A method must adapt to the client's response without losing clinical coherence.
tasks.human_edge: The psychologist notices distress, rupture or misunderstanding and responds sensitively.
tasks.altitude: Treatment responsibility and session time stay unchanged.

reach.task: Explain agreed support needs through appropriate clinical coordination

evidence.claim: Retaining psychological treatment delivery is an E1 assessment from model knowledge; documentation products do not establish therapy replacement.

assumptions: Boundary is direct treatment, excluding plan development and clinical documentation tasks.
Existing planning work supplies the agreed approach; client response remains observed and interpreted by the psychologist, with no free emotion or treatment-success flag.
Retain current guidance; no custom therapy tool proposed.
Zero upkeep because no workflow change is introduced; confirm national professional scope.
research_questions: Which client responses require immediate adaptation or specialist consultation?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 net0; treatment sessions retain all time without importing separate note-writing savings.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop treatment plans from client interests, abilities and needs

steps.what: Develop therapeutic plans with clients based on their interests, abilities and needs

tasks.design: Retain shared formulation of therapeutic goals and approach. Clinical evidence in the health record, represented by {OTHER}, informs the discussion; a generated plan cannot establish what the client needs or accepts.
tasks.previous_blocker: Treatment planning depends on formulation and the client's priorities.
tasks.enabler_now: Record access supports discussion without replacing collaborative clinical judgement.
tasks.still_hard: A feasible clinical approach may conflict with the client's circumstances or wishes.
tasks.human_edge: The psychologist negotiates meaningful goals and recognises uncertainty.
tasks.altitude: Planning responsibility and time stay unchanged.

reach.task: Explain agreed goals for coordinated support

evidence.claim: Keeping client-centred treatment planning human is an E1 assessment from model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is agreeing goals and general approach; therapy frequency and implementation belong to the separate task. If the same planning encounter performs both, roll-up assigns it once.
Client supplies priorities and psychologist interprets existing assessment; no free structured suitable-treatment decision is assumed.
Retain native clinical record access; no custom planning system proposed.
Zero upkeep because no workflow changes; no separate paperwork baseline is invented.
unknowns: Actual planning boundaries and client communication needs
research_questions: Which aspects of the proposed approach require further client discussion before agreement?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 net0; shared formulation and clinical planning retain full time, with overlap assigned once.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Specify and implement individual therapy plans

steps.what: Specify individual treatment type, frequency, intensity and duration with the client
Implement the individual treatment plan and coordinate agreed therapy arrangements

tasks.design: Retain clinical specification and coordination of individual therapy. The approved plan can be recorded in the health record, represented by {OTHER}; no model chooses intensity or duration and no automatic treatment commitment is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Dose and duration depend on clinical needs and practical circumstances.
tasks.enabler_now: Record tools support coordination without validating individual therapy parameters.
tasks.still_hard: Availability or changing needs can require reassessment of the proposed arrangement.
tasks.human_edge: The psychologist judges whether the planned intensity is appropriate and acceptable.
tasks.altitude: Clinical parameter decisions and coordination time remain unchanged.

reach.task: Clarify implementation barriers for an agreed therapy plan
reach.learn: Clinical escalation and coordinated care boundaries

evidence.claim: Retaining individual therapy specification and implementation coordination is an E1 assessment from model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is detailed therapy parameters and implementation coordination, excluding direct therapy delivery and the same goal-setting actions already owned by the adjacent planning task.
The existing clinical planning process produces goals and assessment; s1 produces the agreed parameters before s2. No free appropriate-duration flag is assumed.
Retain native records and coordination; no custom clinical planning tool proposed.
Zero upkeep because no workflow changes. Care-team execution outside the psychologist remains unchanged and is not counted as psychologist savings.
unknowns: Responsibility split and existing coordination work
research_questions: Which implementation barriers require clinical reassessment rather than scheduling adjustment?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 net0; clinical parameter selection and implementation coordination retain all time. Overlapping planning and treatment actions are assigned once.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Locate relevant research using current clinical learning questions
Read and critically assess research to maintain knowledge of clinical developments

tasks.design: Configure saved keyword searches and alerts in the literature access environment, represented by {DOCS}. The psychologist retains relevance checking and critical reading of originals; no generated review or automatic clinical recommendation is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeating the same research queries adds discovery effort.
tasks.enabler_now: Native saved queries can surface new records without repeating search setup.
tasks.still_hard: An alert can miss terminology changes or retrieve weakly relevant studies.
tasks.human_edge: The psychologist assesses methods, applicability and conflicts with existing evidence.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated discovery work with unchanged critical reading and practice authority.

evidence.claim: Saved keyword searches for recurring research discovery are an E1 design from model knowledge; active-learning screening evidence in the digest does not establish the proposed local saving.

assumptions: Boundary is recurring discovery and critical reading, excluding systematic review production and client-specific advice.

Psychologist s1 produces and maintains topic terms, synonyms, sources, date range and update interval within remaining15 hours; bibliographic providers supply existing research metadata. Missing coverage returns to manual searching.
Use native saved searches before custom code; do not submit identifiable clinical questions or assume a free clinically-relevant label.
The25-hour search baseline is an E1 scenario requiring measurement; if work is only reading, no discovery saving exists.
unknowns: Actual repeated search share and source coverage
research_questions: Do alerts save search setup after counting query maintenance and missed-record checks?

incremental.description: Query drift and source coverage checks

role.altitude: Protect therapy and collaborative planning while shortening repeated literature-query setup where measured.
reach: Refine literature coverage with research librarians
role.ambitious_version: A psychologist who preserves attentive treatment and planning and keeps research discovery current without substituting summaries for understanding.
